json.prompt: A rain dark castle gatehouse at dusk seen from the far side of a moat, one lantern lit, painted, wide still frame, no people

render_arrival.subtitle: Mind the moat. The gatehouse keeper has been expecting someone, though not necessarily you.

recorded_tools.name: sql_run
recorded_tools.description: Run SQL statements in one transaction on a database. DDL is allowed: your scripts are the database administrator.

recorded_tools.name: db_create
recorded_tools.description: Create an empty database. The name is a C identifier.

recorded_tools.name: db_drop
recorded_tools.description: Delete a database and everything in it.

recorded_tools.name: kv_get
recorded_tools.description: Read the value a Key-Value-Ref names, /$db/$key, as text.

recorded_tools.name: kv_put
recorded_tools.description: Write text under a Key-Value-Ref, /$db/$key, and return its sha256. A script is the row /_files/script/<name>.js.

recorded_tools.name: kv_delete
recorded_tools.description: Delete the row a Key-Value-Ref names.

recorded_tools.name: kv_list
recorded_tools.description: List the keys of a database under a prefix with sizes and hashes.

recorded_tools.name: doc_get
recorded_tools.description: Read a document by Document-Ref, /$db/$id/$version, in its encoded form: header 0, references at 1 on, {"$ref": n} in the body.

recorded_tools.name: doc_put
recorded_tools.description: Write a new version of document $id in database $db and move its head. Returns the new Document-Ref.

recorded_tools.name: doc_head
recorded_tools.description: The current Document-Ref of document $id in database $db.

recorded_tools.name: script_run
recorded_tools.description: Run the script /_files/script/<name>.js with args as a task in this worker. Returns its value or exception and the verbose lines it wrote.

recorded_tools.name: script_debug
recorded_tools.description: Run the script as script_run does, tracing every substrate call it makes first.

recorded_tools.name: image_make
recorded_tools.description: Generate an image from a prompt and keep it under /_files/<key>. Returns the key, size and sha256.

recorded_tools.name: render
recorded_tools.description: Show an image by its Key-Value-Ref with a subtitle. No image means black.

recorded_tools.name: console_run
recorded_tools.description: Show the debug console as ctrl-0 does, run one command line in its dash and return its output until the next prompt or the timeout. Debug mode.

recorded_tools.name: console_write
recorded_tools.description: Show the debug console as ctrl-0 does and type text into its dash, returning at once. A line goes when a newline ends it, and the text after the last newline waits for a later write. The console is yours from the first write until console_read sees the prompt. Debug mode.

recorded_tools.name: console_read
recorded_tools.description: Show the debug console as ctrl-0 does and read its output from where the last read ended until the text until shows or the timeout, and whether it timed out. A read whose output ends with the prompt ends your turn at the console. Debug mode.

recorded_tools.name: audit_tail
recorded_tools.description: The end of the audit, the server's one document of every JSLB line in debug mode, laid out for a person: its newest whole entries, oldest first. count is a maximum, as a reply holds the newest entries that fit below line_max. Debug mode only.
